season.evidence: Searched: Mountaineers route page and Outdoor Project/other reports call the traverse an early-season snow climb (about April-June, gullies turn to loose rock after late June); one mid-July report found it nearly snow free. Stored May-Jul stands.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Dated 2011-05-30 (in season) and summited, but the line runs Lena Lake trailhead, Lena Lake, Valley of Silent Men, climbers camp and straight up to the South Brother summit (end 47.6538,-123.1409). It never visits North Peak or the Great Basin, so it is the South Couloir standard route (which already has a track), not the north-to-south traverse.

notes: Only one track on the peak and it is the South Couloir line; none qualifies for the traverse.
